1.title: 概述
content: 這位在西部荒野贏得敬重、同時身為亡鎖幫首領的女牛仔，總能在地平線之外解決她的目標。![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）憑藉她那把可靠的槓桿式步槍「毒蛇（The Viper）」，其射程優於《鬥陣特攻》中幾乎所有的英雄。![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)她不僅能利用精準的槍法爆頭，還能射擊空中的「炸藥（Dynamite）」，讓整個敵方隊伍陷入火海。![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)當你的隊伍需要與敵方保持距離時，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）的技能組表現無人能及。她結合了遠程、範圍傷害（AoE）與爆發傷害的能力，有助於瓦解敵方的攻勢。

1.1.1.title: 操作指南
content: * 不斷變換你的位置以保持距離，並讓敵人措手不及。

* 使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）來瞄準掩體、牆壁和遮蔽物後的敵人。他們會以為自己躲得很安全，直到被爆炸擊中為止。

* 將 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)鮑伯（B.O.B.）派往目標點，為你的隊伍爭取進度並阻止敵人的推進。![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）本人應該盡量避免，甚至根本不該站在目標點上。

1.1.2.title: 對抗策略
content: * 縮短距離。![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西在近距離戰鬥中較為弱勢。設法靠近她並將其擊倒。

* 留意 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）12 秒的冷卻時間。如果她剛使用過，你就可以向前推進。如果她有一段時間沒丟出炸藥，試著站在她的投擲範圍之外。

* 躲避 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)鮑伯（B.O.B.）。他的生命值極高，如果你的隊伍無法迅速將他擊殺，最好離開他的視線（LoS），等待他離開。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 強大的控制能力
* 穩定的傷害輸出
* 優異的據點壓制力
* 操作難度高
* 無法一擊擊殺目標
* 不擅長應對近距離戰鬥

3.1.1.title: 角度控制
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）在佔據角度方面表現極為出色。如果她能先就位，就能保持開鏡狀態，並在敵人轉角出現時立即開火。如果敵人試圖躲在轉角後方，她可以使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）並透過爆炸的範圍傷害（AoE）擊中他們。

3.1.2.title: 穩定的傷害型神射手
content: 與其他神射手如 ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女 和 ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)半藏 相比，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西 能為隊伍帶來更穩定的傷害。多虧了 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）以及較高的射速，她的技能組表現不會大起大落。當她的準度不足以解決敵人時，還可以使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)鮑伯（B.O.B.）來進行收頭。

3.1.3.title: 據點壓力
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 可以說是遊戲中最強的目標型絕招。他能造成高額傷害、擁有大量生命值，且對 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西與其隊伍來說毫無風險。這些特質使他非常適合用來爭奪目標點。![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）的範圍傷害也讓敵人難以在據點上久留。

3.2.1.title: 對操作技術要求高
content: 一個不幸的事實是，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西最大的弱點取決於玩家個人的操作技術。如果你是頂尖高手，且擁有精準的爆頭能力，那麼使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西幾乎不可能表現得太差。反過來說，如果你每兩槍就空一槍，那麼在遊玩她時，要為隊伍帶來價值將會變得非常困難。

3.2.2.title: 無法一擊必殺
content: 由於 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西無法造成一擊必殺，因此在狙擊對決中面對 ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女和 ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)半藏時處於劣勢。特別是在哈瓦那和皇家賽道這類長距離地圖上，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西的站位必須比 ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女或 ![](/data/assets/guide/affc69220cbf88d7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fhanzo.png)半藏更加謹慎。

3.2.3.title: 近距離交戰的困境
content: 雖然艾西（Ashe）可以使用腰射和 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun），但 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）在近距離戰鬥中處於極大劣勢。如果她已經被迫使用過 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun），她將無法防禦突擊型英雄的進攻。此外，大多數高機動性英雄的位移技能冷卻時間都比 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）短，因此即便 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）將他們擊退，他們也能在她的 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）冷卻完畢前再次發動進攻。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：毒蛇（The Viper）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)毒蛇（The Viper）操作技巧
* 不要一次打光所有彈藥
* 務必嘗試保留至少幾發子彈用於瞄準射擊（ADS shots）。在恐慌中為了生存，很容易會想直接腰射掃射。請盡量節省彈藥，並尋找機會切換回瞄準射擊。

* 請考慮到若要擊殺一名滿血 250 生命值的敵人，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西必須連續命中 8 發腰射身體傷害，否則就會被對方反殺！
* 收割低生命值的敵人
* 腰射依然是即時命中（hitscan），且較快的射速使其成為收割那些在瞄準射擊後殘血目標的理想選擇。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：毒蛇（瞄準射擊）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)毒蛇（瞄準射擊）的使用技巧**
* 將大部分的時間花在瞄準射擊（ADS）上

* 瞄準射擊是你的主要傷害來源，也是遊玩 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西 的核心原因。因此，請盡可能多加利用。

* 25% 的移動速度懲罰並不會讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西 變得更容易被追蹤。總體而言，為了閃避迎面而來的火力而取消瞄準並不划算。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）的使用技巧**
* 離我遠點

* ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）最有價值的用途是將側襲者（Flanker）從你身邊擊退。擊退正在跳躍的 ![](/data/assets/guide/55b5862f0bee17fa.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwinston.png)溫斯頓（Winston）可以中斷他的攻擊，並經常迫使他浪費防護力場（Bubble）後撤退。

* 抓準時機在敵人交出位移技能後使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）。
* 佔領高處

* ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）的自我擊退效果非常適合用來搶佔高處位置。當 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）能夠俯瞰戰場、將 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）丟過護盾，並利用高處地形來阻擋來自低處敵人的視線（LoS）時，她的戰力最強。

4.4.title: [E]：炸藥（Dynamite）
content: 關於 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）的技巧

* 不要強行使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）

* 如果沒有明確的目標，請將 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）留給有目標的時候再用。![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）所帶來的傷害、絕招充能以及整體價值非常珍貴，不應浪費。
* 控制轉角

* 特別是在面對試圖不斷靠近你的近距離敵人時，利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）來控制轉角。具體做法是先按住技能不放，直到看見敵人繞過掩體試圖靠近你時，再在他們臉上引爆。造成的傷害會迫使他們撤退，進而確保你的安全。

* 盡可能頻繁地使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）

* 比起不浪費 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）更重要的是要確實使用它。不要整場比賽都在等待一個能炸到 5 個人的機會。只要有機會，就果斷出手。

* 如果不頻繁使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite），你的絕招充能速度將會變得非常緩慢。

4.5.title: 絕招：B.O.B.
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 的使用技巧**
* 仔細瞄準

* 使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 時最糟糕的情況就是搞砸他的站位。每位 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe 玩家都經歷過最令人難過的事，就是 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 跑過了你預期他停下的位置，最後跑到荒郊野外，誰也沒打中。
* 花點時間仔細校準他的衝鋒路徑，並規劃路徑上的建築物與敵人。檢查他可能會卡住的地方，以及你希望他被什麼東西擋下。
* 爭奪目標點

* ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 是極佳的目標點爭奪工具。他跑得很快，所以能迅速抵達目標點。他會犧牲自己，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)Ashe 和她的隊友不必冒著生命危險去佔領目標點。

* 確保你讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 衝向的那面牆能讓他停在目標區域內。有時候他會停在區域外緣。
* 創造交叉火網

* 務必嘗試讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 從與你不同的角度進行攻擊。如果你和 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 都從敵人的正面開火，他們可以輕易避開這兩個傷害來源。反之，如果 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 在敵人後方而你在前方，他們就無法同時防禦兩個角度，為了避開其中一邊的攻擊，就必須將自己暴露在另一邊的火力之下。

5.1.1.title: 遙控引爆（Remote Detonator）
5.1.1.description: 在使用炸藥（Dynamite）後，再次按下技能 2 會使其在 0.5 秒的延遲後爆炸。
content: * 對於在牆後或轉角處無法直接射擊的 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）進行引爆非常有用。

* 此外，這比站在空曠處射擊 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）更加安全。

5.1.2.title: 雙管齊下（Double-Barreled）
5.1.2.description: 使用教練槍（Coach Gun）擊退敵人後，可短暫地再次使用該技能，但擊退效果降低 25%。
content: * 對抗側襲者（Flanker）陣容時效果最佳。你可以利用第一發射擊在自己與敵人之間創造空間，接著再利用第二發射擊來取得更好的位置。

5.2.1.title: 毒蛇之刺（Viper's Sting）
5.2.1.description: 對目標連續命中 2 發狙擊射擊可造成 25 點額外傷害並裝填 1 發彈藥。
content: * 最佳消耗型特殊能力（Perk）
* 在擁有長視線的地圖上，額外傷害非常強大。此加成傷害不受距離衰減影響，因此這額外 25 點傷害在任何距離下都能保持其效力。

* 對於施壓 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg) 坦克（Tanks）也很有用，因為在他們巨大的身軀上連續命中兩發射擊非常容易。
* 額外傷害重置
* 「連續狙擊射擊」會在每次命中、累積 2 發狙擊射擊、未命中狙擊射擊時，或在 3 秒內沒有進行射擊後重置。
* 腰射（Hip fire）射擊不會影響毒蛇之刺（Viper's Sting）的計數器。

5.2.2.title: 空中爆破（Airburst）
5.2.2.description: 炸藥（Dynamite）在空中時的引爆半徑增加 40%，且投擲時會返還 3 發彈藥。
content: * 最佳反制戰士（Bruiser）特殊能力（Perk）
* 當敵方隊伍採取密集陣型（deathball）時，更大的範圍傷害（AoE）能讓你每次使用時燃燒更多目標。

* 增加 ![](/data/assets/guide/6d41bdb3da6b2de8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-viper.png)毒蛇（The Viper）的運作時間

* * 即使你沒有用 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）擊中任何目標，只要 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西（Ashe）在空中將其射爆，就能重新裝填 3 發彈藥。這有助於減少裝填時間，並增加她進行射擊的時間。

* 不要對上 ![](/data/assets/guide/ca4458a60a9fff01.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fkiriko.png)霧子（Kiriko）時選擇此項

* * 增加的範圍傷害（AoE）基本上會被 ![](/data/assets/guide/617631df12ff0fc7.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprotection-suzu.png)保護鈴（Protection Suzu）抵銷。請記住，保護鈴在淨化燃燒等效果時會額外進行治療，因此你會為她提供大量的絕招能量。

6.1.title: 最佳地圖
content: 適合 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西的地圖通常擁有開闊的視野，能讓她發揮其優異的射程優勢。她也能從高處獲益，利用 ![](/data/assets/guide/aa1e1fee6005660a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fcoach-gun.png)雙管獵槍（Coach Gun）跳上去，藉此取得攻擊角度並獲得掩護。擁有封閉目標區域的地圖對 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西來說較為困難，因為她被迫在不擅長的近距離下作戰。此外，如果地圖有許多供側襲者（Flanker）移動的側路，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西將難以同時監控多個角度，導致她無法妥善保護自己。

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 圍繞 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西所建立的隊伍陣容，能透過創造空間讓她將敵人保持在視野範圍（LoS）內，進而發揮她的神射手打法。![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)擁有屏障的坦克能部署在她的前方，讓她可以安全地狙擊目標。其他輸出與 ![](/data/assets/guide/28f559449d0692f6.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Fsupport.svg)支援能透過控場（CC）或傷害壓力將敵人保持在遠處，藉此協助 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西。![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）與 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)鮑伯（B.O.B.）同樣是 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西技能組中不可或缺的要素。協助她維持在 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）有效範圍內的隊友，能讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西更快速地累積 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)鮑伯（B.O.B.）並對敵方後排施加更多壓力。當 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西能夠自由地佔據掩體角度時，她便能掌控視野並摧毀敵方隊伍。

7.1.title: 個別英雄搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/bfc283f3f5c967de.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Freinhardt.png)萊因哈特

* 萊因哈特的 ![](/data/assets/guide/e2b61a19c451876c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fbarrier-field.png)屏障力場（Barrier Field）是讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西站在後方狙擊敵人的完美大型護盾。當面對其他遠程英雄時，擁有前方護盾 ![](/data/assets/guide/9ed520f69c65040c.svg#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Froles%2Ftank.svg)戰士（Tank）的一方在對決中具有巨大優勢。此外，萊因哈特推進至敵方隊伍時會吸引對手全神貫注，這讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西能自由地在開闊處佔位，進而更容易鎖定目標。
![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影

* ![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影與 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西的主要搭配方式是同時擔任互補的角色。當 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西在後方進行狙擊時，![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影則會在側翼分散敵方注意力。只要這兩名英雄同時發動攻擊，敵人轉身專注於其中一人時，就會完全暴露在另一人的威脅之下。此外，當敵方使用機動突襲陣容來反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西時，![](/data/assets/guide/670bb2169385300d.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsombra.png)駭影可以留在後方，隨時駭入前來突襲的敵人。
![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲

* ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西搭配 ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲的「保排」是《鬥陣特攻 2》中最致命的組合之一。傷害增幅改變了 ![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西瞄準射擊（ADS）的傷害門檻，而受到傷害增幅的 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）單獨就能造成近 200 點傷害。有了 ![](/data/assets/guide/c7d7f2bfb765e77e.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fmercy.png)慈悲的協助，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西可以採取更具侵略性的側翼站位，對敵方隊伍構成更大的威脅。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 除了 ![](/data/assets/guide/62383b6520e2bec1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fwidowmaker.png)奪命女之外，![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西在面對《鬥陣特攻》中幾乎所有英雄時，都擁有遠程優勢。

面對艾西時的主要策略是縮短距離，並在對你有優勢的位置發動攻擊。![](/data/assets/guide/1745f43a104480df.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fashe.png)艾西在近距離戰鬥中較為弱勢，但你應該避開她的視野（LoS，Line of Sight），例如走側邊房間或翻越牆壁等，以免在靠近的過程中被她狙擊。

下一件最重要的事是掌握 ![](/data/assets/guide/17c0defbc2244ec8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fdynamite.png)炸藥（Dynamite）12 秒的冷卻時間。如果她剛使用過，你就可以向前推進；如果她有一段時間沒丟了，試著站在她的投擲範圍之外。

如果你擁有可以阻擋炸藥（Dynamite）的屏障或減傷技能，請將阻擋每一次投擲視為你的個人任務。這將能大幅削減她獲得的絕招充能，意味著你面對 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B. 的次數也會減少。

大多數時候，你應該躲避 ![](/data/assets/guide/526e37997ecc8f1a.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fb-o-b.png)B.O.B.。他的生命值極高，如果你的隊伍無法迅速將他擊殺，最好離開他的視野（LoS）並等待他離開（持續 10 秒）。
當然，如果你需要爭奪據點，或者你的隊伍可以撤出他的範圍，那麼你就需要透過射擊他、位移他或阻擋他的射擊來提供協助。

8.2.title: 特定英雄剋星名稱
content: 奪命女
